item.title: [DE|Local] rbb24 Der Tag in Berlin und Brandenburg (Berlin) (Thu 19:17): IT-Lücke an Schulen | Gestapelte Schule | KI-Klagen
item.description:
Originally published Thu 19 Nov 2026 19:17 IST.
Wegen einer Sicherheitslücke wurden am Mittwochnachmittag die Systeme der Berliner Schulen wurden vom Netz genommen. Außerdem: Grundsteinlegung erste Gestapelte Schule in Lichtenberg; KI-generierte Klagen belasten Brandenburgs Gerichte; Riesenwindrad wird in Betrieb genommen.   "DER TAG in Berlin und Brandenburg" – kompakt und informativ mit dem Neuesten aus Ihrer Region. Abonnieren und hören können Sie den Podcast in ARD Sounds. "DER TAG" gibt es auch im Vorabendprogramm im rbb-Fernsehen, immer montags bis freitags 18 Uhr.

item.title: [EN|In-Depth] BBC Global News Podcast (Fri 07:33): Abusers convicted in Joanne Young case echoing Pelicot
item.description:
Originally published Fri 20 Nov 2026 07:33 IST.

In the first trial of its kind in England, four men have been convicted of raping and sexually abusing a British woman, in a harrowing case that bears similarities to that of Gisèle Pelicot in France. Like Pelicot, Joanne Young chose to allow her name to be made public, after discovering that her then-husband had advertised her online to strangers for sex, repeatedly drugged her and raped her. British police sought the expertise of French investigators on the Pelicot case to assist them in bringing Young's former husband and her other abusers to justice.

Also: AI tech giant Anthropic becomes one of the world's most valuable public companies after its stock market debut. Meanwhile Meta says it is ''re-evaluating'' its 2030 climate goals as the demand for AI data centres drives up emissions. A spacecraft that has been on an eight year journey through outer space is set to enter orbit around Mercury. We hear the Ukrainian view on the face-to-face meeting between Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping. Islam is expected to surpass Christianity as the world’s largest religion by 2035. We meet the winner of the International Children's Peace Prize, 17-year-old Colombian climate activist Francisco Vera Manzanares. And who are the candidates challenging Fifa President Gianni Infantino for the top job in world football?

The Global News Podcast brings you the breaking news you need to hear, as it happens. Listen for the latest headlines and current affairs from around the world. Politics, economics, climate, business, technology, health – we cover it all with expert analysis and insight.
